    • singleStep

      public void singleStep() throws Exception
      EXPLANATION: This method advances the simulation by exactly one step (0.05s). It is called by the GUI's AnimationTimer loop. Useing this instead of the while-loop in makeConnection so the GUI stays responsive and synchronized.
      Löst aus:
      Exception
